_comment: Canonical wave-spawn schedule for the Avalon village defense loop (Defenders of the Realm v2 Unity port). Each wave is preceded by a calm Prepare Phase countdown; when the countdown hits zero the WaveManager spawns the wave's enemy batches at the named WaveSpawnPoints. Wave 1 is the v2-foundation acceptance wave: 8 Hollow Walkers entering from the NORTH gate (port spec Week 4 'Wave 1 = 8 Hollow Walkers from the north gate'). The countdown timings are sourced VERBATIM from the React v1 stream (src/modules/village/waves/waveConfig.ts — PREPARE_SECONDS=45 for the first wave, LATER_PREPARE_SECONDS=300 after). Per-wave enemy counts follow React src/data/battleScaling.ts waveScaling().enemyCount (wave 1 = 8, then 8 + steps*2 capped at 12). Waves 2-3 are AUTHORED here as a defensible continuation so the WaveManager has a multi-wave schedule to drive — the React stream only parameterises waves procedurally, it has no literal wave-2/3 table; flagged in docs/port-notes/week4-waves.md.

_schemaNotes.countdownSeconds: Seconds of calm Prepare Phase BEFORE this wave spawns. Wave 1 = 45s (React PREPARE_SECONDS) so a new player isn't staring at a multi-minute timer; later waves = 300s (React LATER_PREPARE_SECONDS) build window.
_schemaNotes.spawnPoint: WaveSpawnPoint.SpawnId the batch materialises at — 'spawn-0' N, 'spawn-1' E, 'spawn-2' S, 'spawn-3' W. Parallels the four cardinal gates (gate-0..gate-3). Wave 1 uses spawn-0 (north) only.
_schemaNotes.enemies: Ordered list of spawn batches. Each batch: { type (enemies.json id), count, spawnPoint, delay (seconds after the wave starts before THIS batch begins spawning), interval (seconds between each enemy in the batch) }.
_schemaNotes.type: Keys into enemies.json 'id'. Wave 1 uses 'hollow-walker' exclusively.
_schemaNotes.delay: Seconds after countdown-zero before the batch starts releasing enemies. 0 = release immediately on wave start.
_schemaNotes.interval: Seconds between successive enemy spawns within the batch. Staggers a march rather than dumping the batch in one frame.
_schemaNotes.boss: Optional. When present, names a boss enemy (enemies.json id) released alongside the wave. Boss waves recur every 6 waves (React BOSS_EVERY) — none of waves 1-3 are boss waves.
